title: The Windy day on the coast
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：windy　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 windy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the painter wrote of ① a windy day on the coast in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② windier than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the windy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the windiest day on the coast anybody in the studio had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too windy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the windy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a windy hill above the town, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as windy as the hill above the town they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was windy or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something windy, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite windy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the windy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another windy day on the coast in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ windier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The windiest hill above the town in the whole studio, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the windy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有风（前置定语 a windy day on the coast：1991 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件有风的一天）
B. adj. 有风／多风（比较级 windier than：文中两处，一处比海边有风的一天，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有风／多风（最高级 the windiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有风（表语 too windy to do：母亲觉得它太有风，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 多风（前置定语 a windy hill above the town：叔叔把整件事称作一桩多风的山岗）
F. adj. 多风（同级比较 as windy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩镇上风大的山岗相比）
G. adj. 多风（后置定语 something windy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 多风（受程度副词修饰 quite windy：那位观者的评价）

items.q: a windy day on the coast
the windiest day on the coast anybody
a windy hill above the town
The windiest hill above the town in

answers.why: windy 意为“有风”，1991 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件有风的一天”，此处作前置定语 a windy day on the coast。
windy 意为“有风”，此处用比较级 windier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
windy 意为“有风”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说它是画室里最有风的一件，故用最高级 the windiest day on the coast。
windy 意为“有风”，母亲认为这件东西“太有风了，谁也用不上”，too windy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
windy 意为“多风”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩多风的山岗”，此处作前置定语 a windy hill above the town。
windy 意为“多风”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩镇上风大的山岗一样多风”，同级比较用 as windy as。
windy 意为“多风”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“多风的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something windy。
windy 意为“多风”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当多风”，quite 修饰原级 windy。
windy 意为“多风”，2001 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要多风”，故用比较级 windier than。
windy 意为“多风”，母亲 2003 年说的是“整个画室里最多风的那一桩”，故用最高级 the windiest hill above the town。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件有风的一天。（a windy day on the coast）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有风。（windier than …）
母亲觉得它太有风，谁也用不上。（too windy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩多风的山岗。（a windy hill above the town）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩镇上风大的山岗一样多风。（as windy as …）
到了 1998 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件多风的东西。（something windy）
answers: In 1991 the painter wrote of a windy day on the coast in the catalogue.
Everybody said it was windier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too windy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a windy hill above the town.
He said nobody would call it as windy as the hill above the town they had once had.
By 1998 the catalogue asked for nothing but something windy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 windy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the painter wrote of a windy day on the coast in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the windiest day on the coast in the studio, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too windy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a windy hill above the town, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite windy, and everybody laughed.
The windy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
